# iosxr_hw_module_shutdown_8000 (Resource)

This resource can manage the HW Module Shutdown configuration on Cisco 8000 series routers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxr_hw_module_shutdown_8000" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `location` (String) Location string

### Optional

- `admin_state` (String) Set the admin state of the hw-module
  - Choices: `shut`, `unshut`
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxr_hw_module_shutdown_8000.example "<location>"
```
